Kylie Clayton

Bankruptcy Paralegal

With 15 years of bankruptcy experience, Kylie manages the technical and procedural aspects of Chapter 7 and 13 bankruptcy cases. She enjoys working directly with clients from the beginning to the end of their bankruptcies, always with the goal of making the process less daunting. Kylie earned her bachelor’s degree in political science as well as her paralegal certificate.
